**Short answer:** For most people I'd buy the **Anker Prime Qi2 vent mount**. If you want something cheaper that still has a cooling fan, get the **LISEN Qi2.2 25W** or the **ESR HaloLock CryoBoost**.

## Top picks

**Best overall: Anker Prime Qi2 (vent clip, up to 25W)**
- MountGuys uses it daily in its own car and calls it the best overall. It says the vent clip is more secure than Apple's or Belkin's. ([MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/))
- It has active cooling, and a 60W adapter comes in the box. That adapter is needed for the full 25W. ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/))
- It's the priciest pick, at about $70–90 depending on the sale. The vent clip is narrow, so check your vent slat width first.
- [Buy on Amazon (via MountGuys)](https://amzn.to/4vhoGXa)

**Best value with a big feature set: LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan (about $40)**
- The Gadgeteer ranks it best overall for iPhone 16 and 17. It includes a 95W adapter.
- With the fan off, output drops to 15W.
- The suction base is large.
- [Buy on Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FPFH7BN9?tag=r3media07-20)

**Best budget with a fan: ESR HaloLock Qi2 with CryoBoost (15W)**
- It's Qi2-certified and mounts on a vent or the dash. The fan helps prevent heat throttling, which The Gadgeteer says can drop passive mounts to about 7W in hot cars.
- A car adapter may not be included, and ESR's page doesn't say. Budget about $10–15 for an 18W+ USB-C adapter.
- The price varies by source. The Gadgeteer lists about $19–36. Dealectric lists $39.99 at ESR's store, or **$32.80 with code PARTNER18**, which Dealectric says it tested in ESR's cart on 2026-10-22. Check the final price at checkout.
- [Buy at ESR with the code (Dealectric affiliate link)](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) · [Amazon listing](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0CM3DCWQY?tag=r3media07-20)

## Other options
- **Cheapest Qi2 mount: ESR HaloLock Qi2 (about $20–27).** It has no fan, so it suits cooler climates. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B08HNBHSQV?tag=r3media07-20)
- **PITAKA MagEZ Car Mount Pro 2 (about $60).** It has a nicer build and an NFC Shortcuts trigger, but no fan. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D2NFYR4W?tag=r3media07-20)
- **iOttie Velox Mini Qi2 (about $41).** It's a dash/windshield mount with a car charger included. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0D54Y5THX?tag=r3media07-20)
- **No charging, just a secure hold:**
  - Andobil Vacuum Suction mount for the dash. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0FWJYCJC6?tag=moun05-20)
  - VICSEED steel-core vent mount. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0F916XVSW/?tag=moun05-20)
- **Cup holder, if you have no good vent or dash spot:** EXELIQ 15W. [Amazon](https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0BJ688W1Q/?tag=moun05-20)

## Things to check before buying
- **Qi2 badge:** "MagSafe-compatible" without Qi2 certification may charge at only about 7.5W.
- **Power source:** Your car's built-in USB port usually can't power these. A 15W mount needs an 18W+ USB-C PD adapter, and a 25W mount needs 30W+. Anker's page cites 45W+ for the Prime.
- **Case:** You need a MagSafe-compatible case, or the hold will be much weaker.
- **Windshield mounts:** They're restricted in many states, including CA, MN, and NJ. A vent or dash mount avoids the problem.
- **Reliability:** MountGuys says metal-hook vent clips hold up better than friction-based plastic ones.

Note that the Anker, Andobil and Amazon links above are affiliate links, as is the Dealectric link. Prices come from the review sites and may have changed.

If you tell me your phone model, vehicle type and climate, I can narrow this to one pick.
